issues.problem: Evidence source (competitive analysis/heuristic evaluations) does not demonstrate user research. The candidate has pro bono user research with 15 participants, but it was not cited.
Accessibility certification shows knowledge, but the requirement explicitly demands evidence of applying WCAG 2.1 AA in shipped products. No such application is evidenced.
Data-informed design claim rests solely on a self-reported skills list (Google Analytics, Hotjar) with no work history demonstration of using analytics to validate design hypotheses.
User research tools list does not prove planning and conducting qualitative research. The candidate has pro bono research, but it was not cited.
Journey mapping and IA skills list does not demonstrate synthesis into personas, journey maps, and actionable insights. No work history evidence of creating these artifacts.
Analytics tools list does not prove collaboration with a data analytics team to triangulate findings. No work history evidence of such collaboration.
Interactive prototyping skills list does not demonstrate creation of prototypes. The candidate built a responsive prototype for pro bono work, but it was not cited.
Accessibility certification does not prove application of WCAG 2.1 AA in designs. No evidence of accessibility applied in shipped products.
Agile/Scrum skills list does not prove participation in cross-functional Agile squads. The candidate participated in design sprints during internship, but it was not cited.
Volunteer UX mentoring does not demonstrate participation in cross-squad design critiques and knowledge-sharing sessions. No professional design critique experience evidenced.
